_comment: The recorded E1 SUITE FLOOR, used by scripts/e1-coverage.mjs as a gate.
Why a manifest: a gate needs a recorded value to compare against. Before this,
e1-coverage.mjs printed the floor and always exited 0, so it could report a
number that nothing could contradict — a skill could have lost its suite and
the build stayed green. Coverage that can only go up on paper is not a gate.
must_have_suite: every skill that is recorded as having a dedicated suite. If a
tests/<skill>/ directory disappears, the gate fails and names it. If a suite is
removed deliberately, delete its entry here in the same commit — that is the
model_run_recorded: the number of skills with a blind model-run behavioral
record. This is NOT machine-computable by the script (it needs a model run per
skill), so it is recorded here as data and the script refuses to derive it. As
This file is NOT the E1 behavioral catalog. See scripts/e1-coverage.mjs for the
three-number distinction, and docs/STEAL.md for what remains.
model_run_note: 4 of 25 have a blind model-run behavioral record. Moving this number requires a model run per skill; see docs/STEAL.md for which four and what the command is.
